title: JARVIS — a local, agentic desktop assistant
description: A Jarvis-style AI that controls your Windows computer: it takes a screenshot, reads what is on screen, thinks, and acts — moving the mouse, clicking by coordinate, typing, launching apps, running commands and working with files — looping until the task is done. It runs a small local model via Ollama, built and tuned for a modest machine (RTX 2050 / 4 GB VRAM / 8 GB RAM). Grounding is done with classical tools, not the model: Windows UI Automation and OCR detect the real on-screen controls and their exact bounding boxes, each labelled with a number (Set-of-Marks), so the model only has to answer "click element 0" — which a 1.5–3B text model does reliably.
